subject: general
question: The Lok Sabha passed the Family Courts' Amendment Bill in _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**July 2022.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Family Courts' Amendment Bill **seeks to amend the** Family Courts Act, 1984**, which provides for the establishment of **family courts **for speedy settlement of disputes relating to **marriage and family affairs.**
 
• The **Lok Sabha**, the lower house of the Indian Parliament, passed the Bill in **July 2022**, which means that it has been **approved **by the elected representatives of the people.
 
• The Bill proposes several amendments to the original Act, including the provision for **digital recording of evidence **and the establishment of **counselling centres** to help parties resolve their disputes amicably.
 
• The Bill also seeks to improve the** functioning of family courts** by providing for the appointment of **more judges and support staff,** and by enabling the** transfer of cases **between courts for better case management.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The purpose of the Family Courts (Amendment) Bill is to establish Family Courts in the states of **Himachal Pradesh and Nagaland**, respectively, beginning on **February 15, 2019, **and **September 12, 2008.**
 
• In order to retrospectively recognize all actions performed under the aforementioned Act by the State Governments of Himachal Pradesh and Nagaland, as well as the** Family Courts **of both states, prior to the Family Courts (Amendment) Act, 2022, it also aims to incorporate a new **Section 3A.**
 
• The bill states that any** family court judge appointment orders, **as well as any **posting, promotion, or transfer** of such judges pursuant to the Act, will be enforceable in the two States.
